title: Release Engineering
description: Can cut a versioned, rebuildable release: lockfiles, SemVer, a changelog of user-facing change, and an artifact another engineer can reproduce from the tag.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can tag a commit with a SemVer name, write a changelog line that names a user-facing change, and point at the lockfile the ecosystem expects — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can cut a tagged release whose artifact rebuilds from that commit with the documented command, keep CHANGELOG entries for at least two versions, and write RELEASE.md a mentor can follow without asking a question.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently distinguish patch, minor and major with examples, keep a reproducible dependency inventory, and separate a routine update from an urgent security response in a written policy.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a release that cannot be rebuilt — missing lockfile, unpinned dependency, secret in build config, or a version that does not match the tag — and produce a compatibility or deprecation note that distinguishes API version from application release version.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's release, name a changelog that is only 'updates' or a SemVer bump that hides a break, and teach when a tagged image is the artifact versus a language package on an unfamiliar repository.
